name: CTX_WordPress Suspicious PHP Write by Web Process
xql_query:
// ============================================================
// Rule: CTX_WordPress Suspicious PHP Write by Web Process
// Vendor: Cortex
// Objective:
// Detect activity associated with CTX_WordPress Suspicious PHP Write by Web Process.
// Severity: SEV_040_HIGH
// Category: INFILTRATION
// ============================================================
// MITRE ATT&CK:
// Tactic: TA0003 - Persistence
// Technique: T1505.003 - Server Software Component: Web Shell

config case_sensitive = false

| dataset = xdr_data

| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE

| alter
    web_process_lc = lowercase(actor_process_image_name),
    file_name_lc = lowercase(action_file_name),
    file_path_lc = lowercase(action_file_path)

// Common Windows and Linux web/PHP worker processes
| filter web_process_lc in (
    "w3wp.exe",
    "php-cgi.exe",
    "php.exe",
    "php",
    "php-fpm",
    "php-fpm.exe",
    "httpd.exe",
    "httpd",
    "apache2",
    "nginx.exe",
    "nginx"
)

// WordPress-capable web roots
| filter
    file_path_lc contains "\\wwwroot\\"
    or file_path_lc contains "\\htdocs\\"
    or file_path_lc contains "\\public_html\\"
    or file_path_lc contains "\\inetpub\\"
    or file_path_lc contains "/var/www/"
    or file_path_lc contains "/srv/www/"
    or file_path_lc contains "/usr/share/nginx/html/"

// High-confidence webshell placement patterns
| filter
    file_path_lc ~= ".*[\\\\/]wp-content[\\\\/]uploads[\\\\/].*\\.(php|phtml|phar)$"
    or file_name_lc ~= "^(shell|cmd|c99|r57|b374k|wso|alfa|indoxploit|ghost|bypass|hack|eval|base64|adminer|uploader|downloader)([._-][a-z0-9_-]+)?\\.(php|phtml|phar)$"
    or file_name_lc ~= ".*\\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|txt|log|tmp)\\.(php|phtml)$"

| fields
    _time,
    agent_hostname,
    agent_id,
    agent_ip_addresses,
    actor_effective_username,
    actor_process_image_name,
    actor_process_image_path,
    actor_process_command_line,
    actor_process_image_sha256,
    action_file_name,
    action_file_path,
    action_file_sha256,
    action_file_md5,
    event_type,
    event_sub_type
description: Detecta gravação ou acesso de alto risco a arquivos PHP por processos web/PHP em diretórios WordPress, incluindo PHP em uploads, nomes clássicos de webshell e dupla extensão. O alerta é compatível com pós-exploração wp2shell, mas não prova a cadeia de CVEs.
alert_name: SERVER_WordPress Suspicious PHP Write by Web Process
alert_description: Foi identificado um arquivo PHP suspeito no caminho $action_file_path do endpoint $agent_hostname , associado ao processo web $actor_process_image_name executado pelo usuário $actor_effective_username . O hash observado foi $action_file_sha256 . O SOC deve validar possível webshell ou comprometimento do WordPress.

TA0003 - Persistence: T1505.003 - Server Software Component: Web Shell
